recommended.upstreamPanVK: Not advertised. README marks it highly recommended, not mandatory.
recommended.action: Do not make descriptor_buffer mandatory for the first compliance gate.

HARD_REQUIREMENTS.note: README lists VK_EXT_robustness2 as an extension. robustImageAccess2 is a DEVICE_CREATE check in vkd3d_init_device_caps, not this HARD gate.

requirements.upstreamPanVK: ABSENT at pinned 5a07217 and origin/main e1f3f372; PanVK get_device_extensions omits it (P15 BLOCKED_SAFE_FALSE)
requirements.action: Keep absent. Complete no-IDVS XFB variant, then CTS. Never expose early.

requirements.upstreamPanVK: Pinned and origin/main e1f3f372 still report false (P6 PARTIAL / UNSUPPORTED)
requirements.action: Keep false. Complete robustImageAccess2 semantics, then CTS. Never expose early.

requirements.upstreamPanVK: ABSENT at pinned 5a07217 and origin/main e1f3f372; PanVK omits EXT_transform_feedback (P15 BLOCKED_SAFE_FALSE)
requirements.action: Keep false. Complete no-IDVS XFB variant, then CTS. Never expose early.

requirements.upstreamPanVK: ABSENT at pinned and origin/main; XFB streams need GS (P15 BLOCKED_SAFE_FALSE, waits on P12)
requirements.action: Keep false. Complete XFB plus geometryShader, then CTS. Never expose early.

requirements.upstreamPanVK: ABSENT at pinned 5a07217 and origin/main e1f3f372; v11 XML has no GS stage (P12 BLOCKED_SAFE_FALSE)
requirements.action: Keep false. Complete Valhall v11 GS or PanVK poly/compute lowering, then CTS. Never expose early.

requirements.upstreamPanVK: ABSENT at pinned 5a07217 and origin/main e1f3f372; v11 XML has no TCS/TES stage (P17 BLOCKED_SAFE_FALSE)
requirements.action: Keep false. Complete Valhall v11 TCS/TES or PanVK poly/compute lowering, then CTS. Never expose early.

requirements.upstreamPanVK: ABSENT at pinned and origin/main; no Valhall polygon-mode field (P11 BLOCKED_SAFE_FALSE)
requirements.action: Keep false. Post-vertex primitive expansion, then CTS. Never expose early.

requirements.upstreamPanVK: ABSENT at pinned and origin/main; v11 has no viewport array (P14 BLOCKED_SAFE_FALSE)
requirements.action: Keep false. Hardware proof of v11 ViewportIndex plus per-viewport transform/scissor/depth, then CTS. Never expose early.

requirements.upstreamPanVK: Hardware-dependent; G615 BC mask is 0. No complete PanVK emulation (P9 BLOCKED_SAFE_FALSE)
requirements.action: Keep false until transparent BC contract PASSes. Never advertise early.

requirements.upstreamPanVK: ABSENT at pinned 5a07217 and origin/main e1f3f372; P20 not started
requirements.action: Keep false. Implement pipeline statistics with correct Vulkan counters, then CTS. Never expose early.

requirements.upstreamPanVK: ABSENT at pinned and origin/main; no PanVK clip lowering (P10 BLOCKED_SAFE_FALSE)
requirements.action: Keep false. Primitive-stage clip, then pixel matrix and CTS. Never expose early.

requirements.upstreamPanVK: ABSENT at pinned and origin/main; no PanVK cull lowering (P10 BLOCKED_SAFE_FALSE)
requirements.action: Keep false. Primitive-stage cull, then pixel matrix and CTS. Never expose early.

requirements.upstreamPanVK: ABSENT at pinned and origin/main; XFB queries need EXT_transform_feedback (P15 BLOCKED_SAFE_FALSE)
requirements.action: Keep false. Complete XFB queries after transformFeedback, then CTS. Never expose early.

requirements.upstreamPanVK: G615 reports 64. Profile lists 65536 as a numeric property. Smaller granularity is more capable.
requirements.action: No driver change. Existing evaluator uses >=; actual 64 already satisfies a 65536 max-granularity.

requirements.upstreamPanVK: G615 subgroupSupportedOperations=1791 includes VK_SUBGROUP_FEATURE_BASIC_BIT. Capture stores a bitmask, not a string array.
requirements.action: No driver change. Evaluator compares flattened array string against integer bitmask.

DEVICE_CREATE.smokeReason: Stock vkd3d-proton v2.14.1 vkd3d_init_device_caps requires robustImageAccess2. G615 reports that bit false, so D3D12 device creation returns E_INVALIDARG. Stock vkd3d-proton is a Windows D3D12-on-Vulkan layer; this Android ICD is not a legal host for the tagged binaries. No stock vkd3d binary was launched.

FEATURE_LEVEL.reason: D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL is not available because DEVICE_CREATE fails. Stock vkd3d never reaches CheckFeatureSupport. Machine-evaluated FL profiles remain FAIL and are recorded separately.
